storyboard.spokenMeaning: The post nearly goes out, then is erased again out of fear of judgment and gossip.
storyboard.viewerTakeaway: Post-and-delete is a visible retreat: fear of being judged makes you undo your own progress.

visualNarrative.action: Left headline block fades in: 'POSTING. HAPUS LAGI.' with a quiet sub-line about fear of judgment; right side shows an empty vertical upload bar with a dim draft post card behind it.
visualNarrative.meaning: Sets the ritual before it happens: the intention to post exists, uncommitted.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Headline sits left at 8% margin; bar outline and dim draft card occupy the right third, bar at 0%.

visualNarrative.action: Teal fill climbs the bar in three quick stages to 99%, the gold percent label ticking up with it; the draft card brightens as the fill passes it.
visualNarrative.meaning: The post is essentially ready — the near-complete bar reads instantly as 'about to go out'.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Teal column reaches just below the bar cap, gold '99%' label locked beside it, draft card at full opacity.

visualNarrative.action: A two-beat hold at 99%: the label blinks once, nothing else moves — hesitation visible as stillness.
visualNarrative.meaning: The fear arrives in the gap between finishing and sending.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Frame is static except one soft blink of the gold percent, fill motionless at 99%.

visualNarrative.action: The teal fill drains downward back to zero, the gold label counting 99 → 54 → 12 → 0, and the draft card dims back to hollow outline as the fill passes it.
visualNarrative.meaning: Regression: the act visibly undoes itself — 'hapus lagi' is shown as reversal, not repetition.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Teal column retreats to the bar base, label lands on '0%', draft card returns to dim outline.

visualNarrative.action: The emptied bar and outline card remain while two small labels settle beside them: 'ngejudge' and 'ngomongin' in muted secondary text.
visualNarrative.meaning: Names the two fears that caused the drain without illustrating them literally.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Empty bar at 0%, two small uppercase labels stacked to its left, headline still held on the left.

motionBeats.purpose: Build expectation of a completed upload so the reversal can break it.

storyboard.compositionIntent: leftTextRightObject: headline block locked to the left 8% margin, tall vertical upload bar with tick marks and ghost draft card in the right third, one text block and one dominant object, ~65% negative space between them. Fear labels sit small at the bar's base, never competing with the headline.
visualEvidence: Teal column climbs to just under the bar cap with a gold '99%' label beside it — clearly 'about to send'.
Same column retreats to the bar base and the label lands on '0%' — the post visibly un-sent.
Draft card shifts from lit rectangle to hollow outline exactly as the fill passes it.
Two small uppercase fear labels appear only after the bar is empty, linking cause to result.
forbiddenInterpretations: No looping upload/retry animation — this is a one-way reversal, not a repeating cycle.
No phone mockup, social-media UI, or notification icons — keep the abstract bar.
No red delete button or trash can; erasure is shown by the drain, not a literal icon.
No crowd of judging faces or pointing arrows at a person.
No countdown clock, glitch effects, or particle bursts on the drain.
storyboard.noveltyIntent: Unlike prior progress bars that fill or compare two static bars, this one visibly regresses from 99% to 0% inside one beat, making self-cancellation the motion itself.
